name: usage-insights
description: Standalone re-implementations of Claude Code's faithfully-reproducible built-in slash commands, reverse-engineered from the CLI binary so they run without the built-in tooling: /usage (token/cost breakdown plus an agent analysis of where the API calls went), /insights (transcript scan, facet classification, and a self-contained shareable HTML report), /init (generate a CLAUDE.md), /review (fetch and review a GitHub pull request), and /team-onboarding (co-author an ONBOARDING.md from how you actually use Claude Code).
